claim: With data_seed 1 (seeds 75-77, N=64, e<=0.5, 600 steps), the core pattern from data_seed 0 holds in all 3 seeds, but one pre-registered timing criterion fails. The best-layer (layer 4) accel_step margin is 0.149-0.168: R2 0.914-0.918 against controls of 0.750-0.766, about 0.64-0.67 of the possible headroom. The force margin stays below 0.1 at 0.085-0.099: R2 0.606-0.643 against controls of 0.509-0.545, about 0.19-0.22 of headroom. accel_step forms persistently at steps 80, 90 and 120, and every one of these is before val_mse_ratio first drops below 1 (step 180 in all 3 seeds). Seed 77's formation at step 120 is outside the predicted [60, 110] window but inside the [50, 130] tolerance in the falsification criteria.
confidence_note: This is not a refutation: none of the expected-if-false conditions holds in 2 or more seeds. It is also not fully supported, because the expected-if-true outcome required all 3 formation steps to fall in [60, 110], and seed 77 missed by one checkpoint (margin 0.094 at step 110, 0.102 at step 120). Formation steps were read from the trajectory as the first checkpoint after which the margin stays at or above 0.1 (strict >=). For all 3 seeds they match probes_final.formed_at_step (80, 90, 120). The accel_step control R2 (0.750-0.766) falls inside the range seen with data_seed 0 (0.709-0.778). The early force transient also replicates: margin 0.11-0.19 at steps 10-30, then 0-0.04 by steps 40-70. Two things limit the 'force does not beat control' half of the claim. First, the force margin is close to the bar (seed 75: 0.0988 unrounded). Second, it is still rising at step 600, by about +0.01 per 100 steps after step 400, while accel_step has levelled off. That part of the claim is therefore specific to 600 steps of training; longer runs would likely push force past 0.1. This experiment covers only one new dataset. A second data_seed, or a pooled look at all N=64, e<=0.5 seeds, showing formation in [60, 130] would turn this into 'supported'. A force margin above 0.1 at 600 steps on another data_seed would weaken the force half of the claim.

notes.text: Response to review r-20261013-014714-4f3e (issue 1): Accepted. From step 400 to 600 the force margin rises +0.008 per 100 steps in seed 75 and only +0.003 per 100 steps in seeds 76 and 77, so 'about +0.01 per 100 steps' was overstated. Extrapolating, seeds 76 and 77 would reach 0.1 only after several hundred more steps, if they ever do, so 'longer runs would likely push force past 0.1' was not justified. The early-transient description should read: margin 0.11-0.19 at steps 10-20, 0.08-0.09 at step 30 in seeds 75/76, and then 0-0.04 by steps 40-70 in seeds 75 and 77, while seed 76 stays at 0.038-0.062. I am not guessing at the answer. This cycle runs the same config (data_seed 1, seeds 75-77) to 1500 steps with 50-step checkpoints and a pre-registered rule: force reaching >= 0.1 in 2 of 3 seeds versus staying < 0.1 in 2 of 3 seeds. Status stays inconclusive.

Response to review r-20261013-014714-4f3e (issue 2): Accepted. The expected_if_true window was [60, 110]. [50, 130] was only the falsification tolerance, so offering to re-score against [60, 130] would have moved the goalposts. Seed 77 forms at step 120 (0.0945 at step 110, 0.1015 at step 120) and fails the window as written. The result therefore falls between the two branches: neither is met, and inconclusive is the correct status. Pooling other runs cannot promote it. Upgrading would need a new pre-registered experiment with the window fixed before the run.

Response to review r-20261013-014714-4f3e (issue 1): Accepted. From step 400 to 600 force rises +0.008/100 (seed 75) and +0.003/100 (seeds 76 and 77), not ~+0.01/100. At those rates seeds 76 and 77 would need roughly 100-500 more steps to reach 0.1, and only if the growth continues, so 'longer runs would likely push force past 0.1' was overstated for 2 of 3 seeds. The transient summary is also corrected. Step-30 margins in seeds 75 and 76 are 0.089 and 0.081. Seed 76 stays at 0.038-0.062 over steps 40-70. The transient is therefore 0.11-0.19 at steps 10-20, not 10-30, and it decays to 0-0.06. Rather than argue the extrapolation, this cycle runs the same config (data_seed 1, seeds 75-77) to 1500 steps with a pre-registered rule: persistent force formation in at least 2 of 3 seeds counts as training-length dependent; a final margin < 0.10 in at least 2 of 3 counts as levelled off below the bar. Status stays inconclusive.

Response to review r-20261013-014714-4f3e (issue 2): Accepted. The pre-registered expected_if_true window was [60, 110]. [50, 130] was only the falsification tolerance. Seed 77 forms at step 120 (0.0945 at 110, 0.1015 at 120), so it fails the window as written. Saying a pooled [60, 130] result would make this 'supported' would have moved the goalposts, and I withdraw it. This finding stays inconclusive: neither branch was met in full. Any pooled cross-data_seed timing claim will be pre-registered as a new experiment with its own window, not used to re-score this one.
